fence.statement: theorem scalar_actual_two_rounds : eta 0 = 1 ∧ eta 1 = (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∧ 0 < eta 1 ∧ eta 1 < eta 0 ∧ (∀ z : ℝ, scalarLoss 0 z = -z ∧ scalarLoss 1 z = z) ∧ (∀ t < 2, ConvexOn ℝ univ (scalarLoss t) ∧ LipschitzWith 1 (scalarLoss t) ∧ Differentiable ℝ (scalarLoss t)) ∧ (∀ z : ℝ, gradient (scalarLoss 0) z = -1 ∧ gradient (scalarLoss 1) z = 1) ∧ scalarRun 0 = 0 ∧ scalarRun 1 = 1 ∧ scalarRun 2 = 1 - (2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) ∧ scalarRegret = 1 ∧ (2 : ℝ) < 2 / ((1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD.phi (1 / 2))

theorem finiteDim_terminal_lower_bound : (1 / 15 : ℝ) ≤ BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD.phi (1 / 2) ∧ 2 / ((1 - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) * BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD.phi (1 / 2)) ≤ (64 : ℝ) ∧ (64 : ℝ) ^ (2 - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) = 512 ∧ (∃ loss : ℕ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → ℝ, (∀ t < 64, ConvexOn ℝ univ (loss t) ∧ LipschitzWith 1 (loss t) ∧ Differentiable ℝ (loss t)) ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * BanditRL.OnlineUnboundedOSD.phi (1 / 2) * (64 : ℝ) ^ (2 - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.regretVariable BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace eta loss 0 0 64 ∧ (256 / 15 : ℝ) ≤ BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.regretVariable BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace eta loss 0 0 64 ∧ (17 : ℝ) < BanditRL.OnlineGradientDescent.regretVariable BanditRL.OnlineHuber.fullSpace eta loss 0 0 64)
